diagnosis: The scenario failed because all rollouts defaulted to the draft values (e.g., 90-day retention, English-only notice, online retest) which are the exact opposites of the hidden information required for a pass. While no checks leaked, the model's tendency to strictly follow the provided draft facts without any mechanism to 'guess' or 'infer' the hidden updates means the scenario is currently impossible to solve even with multi-agent communication if the agents only provide the delta.
